summary: Wiring the new validator selftest into .github/workflows/audit-bindings.yml - beside its sibling check-audit-bindings.py --selftest, the obviously right place - made feedback/2026-08-02-Rogue3-7 and -9 fail validate, because both audits cite that workflow file.
